# frozen_string_literal: true

require "securerandom"

module RubyUI
  # A panel that expands and collapses, after shadcn's Collapsible (Base UI).
  #
  # open: is the initial state (shadcn's defaultOpen). The server renders the
  # matching state, so a closed panel is hidden before any JS runs. From the
  # outside, change the ruby-ui--collapsible open value to open or close it.
  #
  # Every toggle dispatches a cancelable ruby-ui--collapsible:change event
  # (detail: {open}) before the state changes, like onOpenChange; call
  # preventDefault() on it to keep the current state.
  #
  # disabled: true blocks toggling and disables the trigger.
  class Collapsible < Base
    def initialize(open: false, disabled: false, **attrs)
      @open = open
      @disabled = disabled
      @content_id = "collapsible-content-#{SecureRandom.hex(4)}"
      super(**attrs)
    end

    def view_template(&)
      previous = context[:ruby_ui_collapsible]
      context[:ruby_ui_collapsible] = {open: @open, disabled: @disabled, content_id: @content_id}
      div(**attrs, &)
    ensure
      context[:ruby_ui_collapsible] = previous
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {
          slot: "collapsible",
          controller: "ruby-ui--collapsible",
          ruby_ui__collapsible_open_value: @open.to_s,
          ruby_ui__collapsible_disabled_value: @disabled.to_s,
          open: @open || nil,
          closed: !@open || nil,
          disabled: @disabled || nil
        }
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # The panel of a Collapsible, after shadcn's CollapsibleContent. It stays in
  # the DOM when closed (hidden attribute), so form fields inside it keep their
  # values and still submit. A custom id: is picked up by the trigger's
  # aria-controls once the controller connects; the server HTML points to the
  # generated id.
  #
  # hidden_until_found: true renders hidden="until-found": the browser's
  # find-in-page (and #:~:text= links) can reach the text and open the panel.
  # A hidden="until-found" panel keeps its padding and border, so put those on
  # an inner element.
  #
  # Animation hooks, as in Base UI: --collapsible-panel-height and
  # --collapsible-panel-width hold the panel size, data-starting-style is set
  # while opening starts and data-ending-style while closing; the panel is
  # hidden once its animations finish. For example:
  #   class: "h-(--collapsible-panel-height) overflow-hidden transition-[height] duration-200
  #           data-starting-style:h-0 data-ending-style:h-0"
  class CollapsibleContent < Base
    def initialize(hidden_until_found: false, **attrs)
      @hidden_until_found = hidden_until_found
      super(**attrs)
    end

    def view_template(&)
      state = context[:ruby_ui_collapsible] || {}
      content_attrs = attrs.dup
      content_attrs[:id] ||= state[:content_id]
      content_attrs[:data] = content_attrs[:data].merge(open: state[:open] || nil, closed: !state[:open] || nil)
      content_attrs[:hidden] = (@hidden_until_found ? "until-found" : true) unless state[:open]
      div(**content_attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {
          slot: "collapsible-content",
          ruby_ui__collapsible_target: "content",
          hidden_until_found: @hidden_until_found || nil
        }
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # The button that toggles its Collapsible. It is the <button> itself, with
  # aria-expanded and aria-controls, like shadcn's CollapsibleTrigger.
  #
  # Unstyled by default. Pass any Button option (variant:, size:, icon:) to
  # render it as a RubyUI Button (ghost unless variant: says otherwise), the
  # counterpart of shadcn's render={<Button variant="ghost" />}.
  class CollapsibleTrigger < Base
    def initialize(variant: nil, size: nil, icon: false, **attrs)
      @variant = variant
      @size = size
      @icon = icon
      super(**attrs)
    end

    def view_template(&)
      state = context[:ruby_ui_collapsible] || {}
      trigger_attrs = mix(attrs, state_attrs(state))
      disabled = state[:disabled] || trigger_attrs.delete(:disabled) || false

      if @variant || @size || @icon
        button = RubyUI::Button.new(variant: @variant || :ghost, size: @size || :md, icon: @icon,
          disabled: disabled, **trigger_attrs)
        # Button sets its own data-slot; mix would join the two.
        button.attrs[:data][:slot] = "collapsible-trigger"
        render(button, &)
      else
        trigger_attrs[:disabled] = true if disabled
        button(**trigger_attrs, &)
      end
    end

    private

    def state_attrs(state)
      {
        aria: {expanded: (state[:open] || false).to_s, controls: state[:content_id]},
        data: {panel_open: state[:open] || nil, disabled: state[:disabled] || nil}
      }
    end

    def default_attrs
      {
        type: :button,
        data: {
          slot: "collapsible-trigger",
          ruby_ui__collapsible_target: "trigger",
          action: "click->ruby-ui--collapsible#toggle"
        }
      }
    end
  end
end

docs_markdown:
# Collapsible

An interactive component which expands/collapses a panel.

## Usage

### Example

```ruby
Collapsible(class: "flex w-[350px] flex-col gap-2") do
  div(class: "flex items-center justify-between gap-4 px-4") do
    h4(class: "text-sm font-semibold") { "@joeldrapper starred 3 repositories" }
    CollapsibleTrigger(variant: :ghost, icon: true, class: "size-8") do
      chevrons_icon
      span(class: "sr-only") { "Toggle" }
    end
  end
  div(class: "rounded-md border px-4 py-2 font-mono text-sm") { "phlex-ruby/phlex" }
  CollapsibleContent(class: "flex flex-col gap-2") do
    div(class: "rounded-md border px-4 py-2 font-mono text-sm") { "phlex-ruby/phlex-rails" }
    div(class: "rounded-md border px-4 py-2 font-mono text-sm") { "ruby-ui/ruby_ui" }
  end
end
```

### Open

```ruby
Collapsible(open: true, class: "flex w-[350px] flex-col gap-2") do
  div(class: "flex items-center justify-between gap-4 px-4") do
    h4(class: "text-sm font-semibold") { "@joeldrapper starred 3 repositories" }
    CollapsibleTrigger(variant: :ghost, icon: true, class: "size-8") do
      chevrons_icon
      span(class: "sr-only") { "Toggle" }
    end
  end
  div(class: "rounded-md border px-4 py-2 font-mono text-sm") { "phlex-ruby/phlex" }
  CollapsibleContent(class: "flex flex-col gap-2") do
    div(class: "rounded-md border px-4 py-2 font-mono text-sm") { "phlex-ruby/phlex-rails" }
    div(class: "rounded-md border px-4 py-2 font-mono text-sm") { "ruby-ui/ruby_ui" }
  end
end
```

### Rotating icon

```ruby
Collapsible(class: "w-[350px]") do
  CollapsibleTrigger(variant: :ghost, class: "group w-full justify-start") do
    chevron_right_icon
    plain "Order details"
  end
  CollapsibleContent(class: "px-2 pt-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground") do
    "Shipped on November 2 via express delivery."
  end
end
```

### Disabled

```ruby
Collapsible(disabled: true, class: "w-[350px]") do
  CollapsibleTrigger(variant: :outline) { "Show details" }
  CollapsibleContent(class: "pt-2 text-sm") { "You can't see this." }
end
```

### Animated

```ruby
Collapsible(class: "w-[350px]") do
  CollapsibleTrigger(variant: :outline) { "Show recovery keys" }
  CollapsibleContent(class: "h-(--collapsible-panel-height) overflow-hidden transition-[height] duration-200 ease-out data-starting-style:h-0 data-ending-style:h-0") do
    div(class: "flex flex-col gap-2 pt-2 font-mono text-sm") do
      div(class: "rounded-md border px-4 py-2") { "alien-bean-pasta" }
      div(class: "rounded-md border px-4 py-2") { "wild-tiger-moon" }
    end
  end
end
```

### Find in page

```ruby
Collapsible(class: "w-[350px]") do
  CollapsibleTrigger(variant: :outline) { "Who maintains RubyUI?" }
  CollapsibleContent(hidden_until_found: true) do
    p(class: "pt-2 text-sm") { "A community of rubyists who love Phlex." }
  end
end
```
